question: How many sessions did Rowan attend last week?

plan.reading: "Last week" is taken as the final week of the plan period (Mon 2026-01-26 to Fri 2026-01-30), not the week before today. "Sessions attended" means therapy contacts in the classes the plan counts, held with the patient present.
other_readings: Sessions as all contacts held with the patient present, including classes the plan does not count
Sessions as all encounters recorded, whatever their status
plan.notes: The question gives only the first name "Rowan". It is taken to mean Rowan Mercer (HG-M042), the only Rowan in the collection. "Last week" is read against the record's own dates, not today's date (2026-09-30).
